Final Edict detonates for {verdictSingleDamage} Holy damage. Dawnfall detonates for {verdictAreaDamage} Holy damage within {verdictAreaRadius} m, reduced beyond {verdictAreaCap} targets. Neither detonation scales with Spell Power. Only one enemy can bear your mark.

May Wyndlewood collect usage and performance data? If you agree, the game sends coarse counters (sessions, play time in five-minute steps, a rough frame rate) and periodic performance reports about your device and frame times to our own servers.

Leave the lane before it fires.
After a {warn} sec warning, a cursed anchor is hauled {length} yd back along its lane over {seconds} sec, hitting everyone it passes: {min} to {max} damage.
After a {warn} sec warning, everyone in an {length} yd lane takes {min} to {max} damage and he dashes along it.
Stand in a gap between the lanes.
After a {warn} sec warning, {lanes} parallel lanes {length} yd long fire at once: {min} to {max} damage to anyone in a lane.

A hovering ghost captain patrols the Lower Bailey moat, and the drawbridge stays shut until he is dead. He cycles three lane attacks aimed at a player who is not the tank, each drawn on the floor before it fires.
His first move comes {first} sec after the pull, then Spectral Broadside, Cursed Anchor and Phantom Boarding in turn, {recovery} sec apart. He stands still during each move.
The tank picks them up. Step away from a sailor that just died.
At {first} and {second} health, {count} Wreckbound Sailors join the fight. A sailor bursts with soul energy shortly after it dies.
Watch the floor: every move is drawn before it fires. Stand in the Broadside gaps.
Spectral Broadside hits hardest: heal whoever stood in a lane.
Keep him in place and pick up the Wreckbound Sailors. His lanes aim at the others, not at you.
Nobody but the tank stands within {radius} yd of the tank.
Each of his melee hits also strikes every other player within {radius} yd of the tank for {share} of the swing.
The tank drags him out of the pool. Everyone else steps out of it.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then a {radius} yd pool of holy brine under him for {seconds} sec: {perSecond} damage per second to anyone in it. While he stands in any pool he takes {shield} less damage.
Stay spread: more than {reach} yd from everyone else.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast at a player who is not the tank. The shield hits them for {min} to {max}, then rebounds to the nearest unhit player within {reach} yd, up to {hits} players.
Spread out and Rebounding Bulwark, Sentence of the Tide and Reaping Arc each hit only one player.
Anyone within {reach} yd of a struck player takes the rebound, and anyone within {radius} yd of the tank takes the splash.
Brine pools are {radius} yd, the shield rebounds to {hits} players, the Sentence column is {sentence} yd, and {count} Sergeants rise.
The tank gathers the Sergeants; everyone kills them, then bursts Olen while he is stunned.

Once, at {health} health: he kneels and channels for up to {max} sec, immune to damage, while {count} Drowned Sergeants rise and attack players who are not the tank. Kill them all and he is stunned for {stun} sec and takes {vuln} more damage for {vulnSeconds} sec.

A fallen paladin knight. His brine pools shield him, so the tank drags him out of them; the group stays spread so his rebounding shield and the Sentence column hit only one player. At half health he kneels, immune, until his Drowned Sergeants die.
He casts one ability at a time; his timers pause during his casts.
At {health} health he kneels, immune, while Drowned Sergeants fight for him.
Marked: move away from the group before the column lands.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast marks a player who is not the tank. {seconds} sec later a column lands on them wherever they are: {min} to {max} damage to everyone within {radius} yd.
Stay spread, more than {reach} yd apart, and away from the tank. In the Oath, kill the Sergeants first.
Rebounding Bulwark and Sentence of the Tide hit hardest when players stand together. Sergeants enrage at low health.
Drag him out of every brine pool. Keep the group out of the {radius} yd around you, where his swings splash.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then a player who is not the tank is hooked; the anchor's landing hits everyone else within {crashRadius} yd for {min} to {max}. After {settle} sec the chain reels them toward the pit. Escape: a lit Mooring Post at least {run} yd away, or {hits} hits on the anchor. Reaching the pit: {pit} of maximum health and a {stun} sec stun.
Hooked: run to a lit post early. Everyone else hits the anchor.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then a player who is not the tank is hooked. After {settle} sec the chain reels them toward the pit. Escape: reach within {reach} yd of a lit Mooring Post at least {run} yd from where you were hooked (that post goes dark for {dark} sec), or the group lands {hits} hits on the anchor. Reaching the pit: {pit} of maximum health and a {stun} sec stun.
A lit post frees the hooked player alone, so the group keeps attacking.
Run to a post, or break the chain?
The post must be at least {run} yd away and goes dark for {dark} sec. Once the chain is short, no post is in reach and only breaking it works.
Tank: use a cooldown. Healers expect the hit.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast at the tank: {mult} times his melee hit, ignoring armor, and {slow} slower movement for {seconds} sec.
The anchor needs {hits} hits and chained players must stay within {range} yd.
Anchor Crash: the anchor hits everyone within {crashRadius} yd of the hooked player.

The gaoler hooks a player with his anchor and reels them toward the drowning pit. They run to a lit Mooring Post or the group breaks the chain. Meanwhile two other players are chained together and must stay close.
At {first} and {second} health, {count} Shackled Prisoners come out of the cells each time.
Chained: stay within {range} yd of your partner.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast chains two players together for {seconds} sec. Every second they stand more than {range} yd apart, both take {min} to {max} damage.
Hit the anchor the moment someone is hooked. When chained, stay close to your partner.
Watch hooked and chained players; the pit takes a large share of health.
Hold him near the middle and pick up the prisoners. Gaoler's Cudgel ignores your armor.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then cages drop on {cages} players who are not the tank. Each cage has {hits} points: each press of the interact key by the prisoner breaks {press}, each hit from an ally breaks {helper}. Inside, rising brine drains health every second. After {max} sec the cage crushes for {crush} of maximum health.
Caged: press the interact key fast. Everyone else hits the cage to break it.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then a cage drops on a player who is not the tank, stunning them. The cage has {hits} points: each press of the interact key by the prisoner breaks {press}, each hit from an ally breaks {helper}, and it slowly mends. After {max} sec the cage crushes the prisoner for {crush} of their maximum health.
Bring them to a quarter health; you do not need to kill them.
At {health} health he lets {count} Shackled Prisoners out. At a quarter health their chains snap and they leave the fight.
Iron Cage locks {cages} players at once.
Brine Flood: a caged player loses health every second until freed.
The gaol keeper locks players in Iron Cages. The prisoner breaks out by pressing the interact key again and again, and teammates speed it up by hitting the cage.
He cages players on a steady timer and frees the prisoners at half health.
Switch to every cage at once and hit it until it breaks.
Top up caged players: the crush is a share of their health.
Hold him and the prisoners; the cages never target you.
Waiting for the beam puts every hit on the real Vael and breaks the veil sooner.
Wait for the beam, or guess?
Every second of the veil the hymn hurts more. Guessing wrong bursts a copy: damage and a stun around it.
Every second of the veil the hymn hurts more. Guessing wrong bursts a copy, which stuns players near it and leaves a Drowned Thrall.
Marked by Death: move forward out of the sweep or behind the pool. Others never stand in front of the marked player.

Every {every} sec he steps through the shadows up to {chain} times in a row, each behind a different player: a pool opens {behind} yd behind them, he rises, and sweeps a {arc} degree arc {range} yd toward them: {min} to {max} damage.
Any hit on a Fog Shade bursts it: {min} to {max} damage and a {stun} sec stun to players within {radius} yd, and a Drowned Thrall rises where it stood.
Do not hit a copy: wait for the beam.
Any hit on a Fog Shade bursts it: {min} to {max} damage and a {stun} sec stun to players within {radius} yd of it.
Each shadow pool stays for {seconds} sec and burns anyone within {radius} yd for {perSecond} damage per second.
Grave Shadow: each shadow pool keeps burning for {seconds} sec.
In the veil the figures drift every {drift} sec, and a burst copy leaves a Drowned Thrall.

A hooded reaper. Three times in a row he rises from a shadow pool behind a player and sweeps a scythe through their back. At {first} and {second} health he hides among identical copies while a hymn hurts everyone; the Fogbeacon's beam shows which figure is real.
He rises from the crown when a player steps onto it. At {first} and {second} health, {count} Drowned Thralls join the fight.
At {first} and {second} health he hides among identical copies.
A {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} damage to everyone within {radius} yd of him. Every {every} sec of open fight; every {lastEvery} sec below {below} health.
When Marked by Death, move forward or behind the pool. In the veil, hit only the figure the beam lights.
When Marked by Death, move forward or behind the pool, and avoid old pools. In the veil, hit only the figure the beam lights.
The Drowning Hymn ramps on everyone until the veil breaks. Mist Surge hits everyone within {radius} yd of him.
Pick up the Drowned Thralls. During the veil, help find the real Vael.

He hides, then four figures rise around the crown: Vael and three Fog Shades, drifting one place every {drift} sec. All four sing the Drowning Hymn for {seconds} sec. The Fogbeacon's beam shows the real Vael. Deal {share} of his health to him to break the veil: a {stun} sec stun and {vuln} more damage taken for {vulnSeconds} sec.
Watch the beam, then everyone hits only the real Vael.

He hides, then four figures rise around the crown: Vael and three Fog Shades. All four sing the Drowning Hymn for {seconds} sec, hurting everyone more each second. The Fogbeacon's beam sweeps every {beam} sec: the real Vael lights up. Deal {share} of his health to him to break the veil: he is stunned for {stun} sec and takes {vuln} more damage for {vulnSeconds} sec.
Tank and healer save their defensive and healing cooldowns for this phase. Everyone else pushes damage to end it fast.
Below {health} health its melee attacks deal {damage} more damage and come {haste} faster, for the rest of the fight.
Every ability on this page hits {scale} times as hard as on Normal.
Below {health} health the boss enrages for the rest of the fight.
Only the tank stands in front. Everyone else stays at its sides.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then fire in a {arc} degree cone, {range} yd in front of it: {min} to {max} damage. Its facing locks for the cast.
Move the drake off the burning ground and step out of it.
The ground under each breath keeps burning for {seconds} sec: {min} to {max} damage per second to anyone on it.
Expect the knockback; keep your back away from edges.
Every {every} sec when someone is close: a {cast} sec cast, then everyone within {radius} yd takes {min} to {max} damage and is knocked back {push} yd.
Barrow Embers: each breath leaves the ground burning for {seconds} sec.
A skeletal drake flies a loop high over the Processional. Walk under it and it lands to fight: a fire breath in front, a tail lash behind and a wing gust around it.
It lands where it is pulled and fights on the ground.
Every {every} sec when someone stands behind it: a {cast} sec cast, then a {arc} degree sweep {range} yd behind it for {min} to {max} damage.
Attack from its sides: never in front, never behind.
The breath and the wing gust are the damage spikes. Stand at its side.
Turn it so the breath points away from the group, and move it off any burning ground on Heroic.
An interrupt stops the Dirge and keeps her quiet for {quiet} sec.
Hiding behind a pillar costs uptime. A missed kick silences and hurts everyone in sight.
Kick every Dirge, and step back out of the first lanes for the third wave.
Below {health} health the Dirge takes {cast} sec and comes every {every} sec, and the organ plays {waves} waves. The third wave reuses the first wave's lanes.
Interrupt it, or break line of sight behind a pillar before the cast ends.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast. If it finishes, everyone who can see her takes {min} to {max} damage and is silenced for {silence} sec. After an interrupt she sings no Dirge for {quiet} sec.
Kill both Choristers within {seconds} sec of each other.
A Chorister that stays dead {seconds} sec while its partner still stands rises again at full health.
Each living Chorister cuts the damage she takes by {per}: {both} while both stand.
Encore: a Chorister dead {seconds} sec while its partner lives rises again.
Unbroken Verse: every {nth} Dirge cannot be interrupted.
Stand between the first lanes, then step into a lane that has already burst.
Every {every} sec she walks to the organ and plays {waves} waves of note lanes down the loft. Each lane shows for {gather} sec, then bursts: {min} to {max} damage.

A choir mistress guarded by two Hollow Choristers who shield her while they live. Her Dirge hurts and silences everyone who can see her, so interrupt it or hide behind a pillar. She also plays the Bone Organ, sending lanes of notes down the loft.
At {health} health she sings faster and the organ plays a third wave.
She sings from the loft with two Hollow Choristers at her side.
Kill the Choristers first, interrupt the Dirge, and dodge the organ lanes.
Kill both Choristers within {seconds} sec of each other, kick the Dirge, and hide from every Unbroken Verse.
A completed Dirge silences you too: hide behind a pillar if no one can kick it.
Hold the Choristers together so they can be killed fast, then take Ilvane.
Hide behind a pillar for it.
Every {nth} Dirge is an Unbroken Verse: it cannot be interrupted.
Using all three lanterns shelters up to {cap} players each, so nobody takes this Lament.
Used lanterns are still dark at the next Lament, so someone takes it then, and each stack of Lingering Lament adds {perStack} damage.

Every {every} sec she seizes {victims} players who are not the tank, lifts them into the air and holds them. Deal {share} of her health within {hold} sec to make her set them down gently. Otherwise she drops them: {min} to {max} damage.
Everyone bursts her as soon as she grabs someone. Healers top up the held player.

Every {every} sec she seizes a player who is not the tank, lifts them into the air and holds them. Deal {share} of her health within {hold} sec to make her set them down gently. Otherwise she drops them: {min} to {max} damage.
Move earlier: on ice it takes longer to reach a lantern.
At {health} health, a {cast} sec cast, then the whole floor becomes slippery ice for the rest of the fight. It cancels a Lament already being cast.
Frozen Embrace seizes {victims} players at once.
A lit lantern burns out on its own after {lit} sec and stays dark {gutter} sec.
Stand in a lit lantern's light before the cast ends.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} damage to every player not sheltered by a lantern. Each hit adds a stack of Lingering Lament: {perStack} more Lament damage per stack, for {seconds} sec, up to {stacks} stacks.

A lit lantern shelters up to {cap} players within {radius} yd from the Lament. A lantern that sheltered anyone goes dark for {dark} sec. On Heroic a lit lantern also burns out on its own after {lit} sec and stays dark for {gutter} sec.
Plan who uses which lantern, and rotate to a lit one for each Lament.
A lit lantern shelters up to {cap} players within {radius} yd from the Lament. A lantern that sheltered anyone goes dark for {dark} sec, so it is still dark at the next Lament.

A ghost bride whose wail hurts everyone who is not sheltered by a grave lantern. Each lantern shelters only two players and then goes dark, so the group has to take turns. She also lifts a player into the air until the group burns her enough to let go.
At {health} health the whole ravine floor freezes for the rest of the fight.
Three grave lanterns stand around the ravine. Her path turns to slippery ice.
Avoid her trail when you need to move fast.
She leaves slippery ice where she drifts; each patch lasts {seconds} sec. On ice you slide and turn slowly.
Burst her the moment she seizes someone. Rotate between lit lanterns for each Lament.
Unsheltered players take the Lament and gain stacks. The held player takes damage while she holds them.
Keep her near the middle so every lantern stays in reach for the group.
Tank: use cooldowns as the stacks rise. Healers watch the tank.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast at the tank: a melee hit that adds a stack of {vuln} more damage taken, up to {stacks} stacks ({max}) for {seconds} sec.
Graves dug at the edge of the yard leave the middle free to fight and dodge in.
Every open grave anywhere raises a Restless Bones at the next Toll, up to {cap} at once.
Every open grave anywhere raises a Restless Bones at the next Toll, up to {cap} at once. On Heroic a grave near the tank also speeds Marrow up.
Gravedigger's Blow: a tank hit that stacks {vuln} more damage taken.
Unquiet Earth: {linger} sec in a grave raises a Restless Bones.
Grave Vigor: inside a grave he attacks {haste} faster.
Marked: walk to the edge of the yard before the grave opens. Never stand in an open grave.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast marks a player. {mark} sec later a grave caves in where they stand: {min} to {max} damage to everyone within {radius} yd. The grave stays open for the fight: inside it you are {slow} slower and take {dirt} damage per second. At most {cap} graves; a new one fills in the oldest.

A raised gravedigger who measures players for graves. Every grave stays open, slowing and burning anyone in it, and each one raises a Restless Bones when he rings his Burial Bell. Dig the graves at the edge of the yard and keep their number down.
At {first} and {second} health he walks to the bell rope and rings the Burial Toll.
He digs graves under marked players and swings his shovel at the tank.
Only the tank stands in front. The tank can step out during the cast.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then a shovel swing in an {arc} degree cone {range} yd in front of him for {mult} times his melee hit. Everyone hit has Dirt in the Eyes: {slow} slower for {seconds} sec.
When marked, carry the grave to the yard's edge. After each Toll, kill the Restless Bones, then return to Marrow.
Burial Toll hits the whole group. Graves slow and burn anyone in them, so help whoever is stuck in one.
Keep him facing away from the group. Pick up every Restless Bones after a Burial Toll.
Keep him facing away from the group and out of every grave. Gravedigger's Blow stacks: use cooldowns as they rise.
Healers top everyone up before the last peal. The tank picks up the Restless Bones; damage dealers kill them.
He walks to the rope and rings the bell for {ring} sec, immune to damage while he walks and rings. Then every player takes {min} to {max} damage, and every open grave raises a Restless Bones.
A player who stays {linger} sec inside a grave raises a Restless Bones from it. That grave then rests for {rest} sec.
The tank keeps him out of the graves.
While he stands inside an open grave he attacks {haste} faster.
Several players relighting at once ends the Rite sooner, before Grave Chill climbs.
Each lighter pays {normal} of their maximum health per candle while the chill keeps rising.
A blocked soul never reaches him: no damage stack and no heal.
The blocker takes the soul's damage. Every soul that gets through adds {per} damage and heals him {heal}.
Step out of the ring at once.
Every {every} sec a {radius} yd ring appears under {count} players. {fuse} sec later hands erupt: everyone inside is rooted for {root} sec and takes {min} to {max} damage.
A spare player steps into each soul's path.

Every {every} sec a Bound Soul drifts from an alcove toward him. If it reaches him he gains {per} more damage per stack (up to {stacks}) and heals {heal} of his health. The first player it touches absorbs it instead: {min} to {max} damage.
Each candle costs the lighter {drain} of their maximum health.
Grasp of the Grave: rings that root and hurt, in every act.
Name the Dead: the candles must be lit in the order the ledger shows.
Light only the candle the beam points at.
The candles must be lit in an order shown by a gold beam from the ledger. A wrong candle snuffs the last one lit and burns the lighter for {min} to {max}.

A lich bishop running a three-act rite. First he calls souls to empower him; at {rite} health he hides behind a ward until the group relights four candles at a cost in health; at {last} health he sweeps a huge scythe.
He pulses shadow around himself and calls souls to feed him.
At {health} health he takes up his scythe for the end of the fight.
At {health} health he returns to the altar and becomes immune until all four candles burn again.
Everyone, the tank included, steps out to {radius} yd before the cast ends.
Every {every} sec ({everyLast} sec in Last Rites), a {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} damage to everyone within {radius} yd.
Only the tank stands in front. The tank can sidestep during the cast.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast at the tank, then a {arc} degree scythe sweep {range} yd in front of him: {min} to {max} damage.
Split the candles between players with health to spare, and burst him in the stun.

Kill Shackles to break the chains you chose, then burn Korgath. Stop every Goadsmith before its Re-rivet ends. Step out of painted lanes and away from pillars that still hold a chain.
Strain, Shuddering Stomp and every freed attack land hard. Each chain left on makes the fight longer; each chain broken adds an attack to heal through.
Hold him in the middle, facing away from the group. Once the Hammer chain breaks, Maul Arc hits everything in front of him. Until the Anvil chain breaks he cannot leave {leash} yd of the middle.
Only the tank stands in front. The tank turns the breath toward ice the group can spare.

Aim his breath, his Plunging Fire and his landing at chosen plates and the rest of the lake stays safe to stand on.

Gather on a plate you can afford to crack, then run out of the shadow before he lands.

Breaths come faster: plan which plates are left to spend.
After the second flight the shard flares: Grave Breath every {breath} sec and Wing Gale every {gale} sec, on the ground.
Keep open water behind you clear, so the push lands you on ice.
A {cast} sec cast, then everyone is pushed {push} yd away from him.
Deep Quench: a cracked plate never refreezes.
Twin Eyes: Wyrm's Eye marks two players at once.
The lake is made of ice plates. His fire cracks an uncracked plate and breaks a cracked one. Deep Quench: on Heroic a cracked plate never refreezes. A broken plate is open water.
Spend ice on purpose: aim his fire at plates the group can afford to lose.
The lake is made of ice plates. His fire cracks an uncracked plate and breaks a cracked one. A cracked plate refreezes after {refreeze} sec. A broken plate is open water.
Get {radius} yd away from him. Start him on a cracked plate and the channel ends at pulse {crack}.

Every {every} sec, and once at {health} health, he channels for {duration} sec: {pulses} fire pulses within {radius} yd, each stronger than the last (the last pulse deals {min} to {max}). Pulse {crack} cracks the plate under him and pulse {brk} breaks it: when it breaks he is Doused and the channel ends.
Never run out of ice: it ends the fight in a wipe.
If every plate is broken, he hovers over the open water and breathes without pause.
A dragon fight on a frozen lake his fire keeps breaking. Every breath spends ice, and the group aims his fire, so the group decides which ice to lose. A wyrm with no ice left breathes without pause.
At {first} and {second} health he takes off and fights from the air until he crashes back down.
He bursts out of the ice and lands in the middle of the lake. His fight starts when he touches down.
After the second flight: Grave Breath every {breath} sec and Wing Gale every {gale} sec on the ground.

Marked: walk to an uncracked plate away from the group. Everyone else leaves that plate.

In the air he marks a player who is not the tank with Wyrm's Eye for {eye} sec. When it ends he pours Plunging Fire on that player's whole plate: a {warn} sec warning, then {min} to {max} damage to anyone on it, and the plate burns. {roundsFirst} rounds in the first flight, {roundsSecond} in the second.
Never stand behind him. Attack from his sides.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then his tail sweeps the {arc} degrees behind him, {range} yd past his body: {min} to {max} damage and a knockback.

Turn Grave Breath onto ice the group can spare, never across the group. Move him onto a cracked plate before a Grave Inferno to cut it short.
Stay on the ice. Leave the water at once if a shove puts you in it.
Standing in open water slows you by {slow} and deals {perSecond} damage per second.
Save healing and defensive cooldowns for the last stretch and finish it fast.
Below {health} health it deals {damage} more damage for the rest of the fight.

A house-sized tusker hauls a sledge of burning soul braziers up and down the Sledge Road. It walks the road in a loop and unhitches the sledge where you pull it. At half health the sledge tips over and spills fire behind it.
Below {health} health it enrages for the rest of the fight.
Two telegraphed attacks from the start: a frontal sweep and a charge down a painted lane.
At {health} health the sledge tips over and soulfire spills behind it.
Walk out of the fire at once and fight away from the patches.
Once, at {health} health: the sledge tips and {count} soulfire patches ({radius} yd) burn behind it for {seconds} sec, {min} to {max} damage per second to anyone inside.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then its tusks sweep a {arc} degree cone in front of it, {range} yd past its body: {min} to {max} damage and a {push} yd knockback.
Attack from the sides or rear. Watch the floor for the painted lane and step out of it. At half health, leave the fire behind it.
Tusk Sweep and Trample are the damage spikes. Stand to its side, not at the far edge where Trample aims, and keep a cooldown for its enrage below {health}.
Hold it facing away from the group and keep still, so the sweep cone never swings into allies. Expect a knockback with every Tusk Sweep.
Step sideways out of the painted lane before the cast ends. The farthest player is the target, so ranged players keep room to side-step.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast paints a {length} yd lane toward the farthest player, then it charges down the lane: {min} to {max} damage and a {stun} sec knockdown to everyone in it.

The tank keeps Bonewalkers out of the water.
A Bonewalker standing in meltwater deals {bonus} more damage.

Bonewalkers keep climbing out of the pools. At {wave1} and {wave2} health an extra wave rises, one from each pool.

Every {every} sec one pool's pyre roars and {count} Raised Bonewalkers climb out {warn} sec later. The pools take turns. At {wave1} and {wave2} health, one more climbs out of each pool.
Kill Bonewalkers only on dry ice, then return to Velkhar. Step out of the Soulfire Trench lane.
Shadow Volley hits everyone every {every} sec. Bonewalkers in meltwater hit {bonus} harder, so watch the tank when they reach water.
Pick up every Bonewalker and drag it onto dry ice, out of the pools and the meltwater strips. In meltwater they hit {bonus} harder.
Pick up every Bonewalker and drag it onto dry ice, out of the pools and the meltwater strips. Keep them moving: one that stands still melts a puddle under itself.

Kill each other's Reflections: never your own.
A {cast} sec channel, then every player gets a Tideglass Reflection with {share} of its health that hunts them. You cannot damage your own Reflection.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast aims a {length} yd lane at a player who is not the tank: {min} to {max} damage.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} damage and an {push} yd knockback within {radius} yd.

Clear the Reflections, then return to the Colossus.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast at a player who is not the tank, then a {arc} degree ice cone {range} yd long: {min} to {max} damage and {slow} slower for {seconds} sec.

Dodge the lane, then use the wall as cover from the Tsunami.
A lane at a player: {min} to {max} damage and a {stun} sec freeze. It leaves an Ice Wall for {wall} sec: standing up to {lee} yd behind it shelters you from the next wave, which shatters it.

{early} sec and {after} sec after each wave two heads combine, in the order Frostlocked Torrent, Venom Current, Toxic Rime.
{after} sec after each wave two heads combine, always in the order Frostlocked Torrent, Venom Current, Toxic Rime.

Spread out, then step out of the pools.
Every {every} sec, up to {count} pools of {radius} yd under different players burst after {warn} sec: {min} to {max} damage, then venom burns there for {seconds} sec at {perSecond} per second.

Hold the heads you can reach; their attacks aim at the others.
Step sideways out of the lane.
Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast aims a {length} yd lane at a player who is not the tank: {min} to {max} damage and an {push} yd shove.

First at {first} sec, then {every} sec after the previous wave ends: a {cast} sec cast while the heads take {reduction} less damage, then a wave crashes over half the pool: {min} to {max} damage and a {push} yd shove.

Every {every} sec a player who is not the tank is marked for {mark} sec. When it ends, {total} damage is split evenly among everyone within {radius} yd of them.

{offset} sec after each Chorus another player is marked for {mark} sec. When it ends, the marked player and everyone within {radius} yd take {damage} damage each.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} frost damage to every player in the court.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast aimed at a player who is not the tank, then a {arc} degree wave {range} yd long: {min} to {max} damage and an {push} yd knockback.
Stack for Chorus, scatter from Solo, kick the aria and step out of Mere Surge.
Stack for Chorus and scatter from Solo at the same time, then leave both spots before the Echo. Kick the aria.
Sea-Song hits everyone every {every} sec. Watch the aria target and anyone a Chorus caught alone.
Watch the Aria target and anyone caught alone by Chorus. During the Score, help sing the next note and heal mistakes.

{count} tears per wave, and the Falling Moon cast lasts {cast} sec.

Every {every} sec, a {cast} sec cast, then {min} to {max} damage to everyone within {radius} yd of her centre.

At {first} and {second} health she calls {count} Moonlight Tears that roll toward her. A tear that touches a player stops: {min} to {max} damage, plus {bonus} more for each Moonsear stack, which lasts {sear} sec. At {health} health half the island floods at once. Every {every} sec the flood switches sides, with a {warn} sec shimmer first. In the water: {perSecond} damage per second and {slow} slower.

Let me sing. Go, and go gently.

There she is. All my life I have asked if she was a goddess or a monster. Show me.

How the boundary between two painted textures looks, across the whole map. A soft brush stores its rim as scattered single cells (one cell can only hold one texture), and the paint grid is a quarter of a yard, so with both of these at 0 a boundary is a hard line with speckle along it, whatever the hardness slider says. Edge softness widens the blend so that scatter reads as the gradual fade it stands for; Edge detail wanders the boundary with fine noise so it interlocks like real ground instead of following the grid. Both are free, no extra texture reads, but a wide softness blurs painted detail narrower than itself.

The tube cuts the ground wherever it breaches the surface, so you no longer line a hole up with the mouth by hand. Buried stretches cut nothing, and ground under a stretch standing above the surface is left alone.

Click the ground to spawn a blue GHOST of the solid, drag it into place and tune it, then press "Lock in cut" (or Enter) to carve a REAL room or tunnel out of the rock: the solid has a walkable floor, rock walls and a ceiling, and it re-meshes the ground around it. A ball makes a chamber, a pitched capsule bored into a hillside a tunnel, a box a hall - and raise Blend so neighbouring carves melt together into one clean cave. Walk in through any face that breaks the surface.

Click the ground to drop an ERASE BOX, size it with the sliders or the gizmo (any width, length and height), then press "Erase caves" (or Enter): every carve, hole and dug volume inside the box is removed, and a carve the box only partly covers is filled back to solid rock where it is covered. One undo step.

The blue ghost is the solid the cut will remove. Drag it into place (click or hold anywhere on the ground), tune its size, shape and depth below, then press "Lock in cut" (or Enter) to commit it - or Cancel / Escape to discard it. Nothing is removed until you commit.
Enter locks the cut in, Escape discards it. Tools 2-4 move, turn and scale the ghost first.

Blue nodes joined by a dotted line are your cave model (visible in every tool). Move a node with the Move tool, raise or sink it with the Y arrow, and scale it to widen the cave there - the tube re-generates live and ALWAYS keeps exactly the size you set. Green ball = entrance, red arrow = exit.

Click the ground to drop the ENTRANCE node, keep clicking to lay blue waypoints (the last one is the exit), then press Generate. The cave is a standalone tube built only from your nodes - the surrounding terrain never squishes or reshapes it. Turn on "Carve its own mouth" and the tube opens the ground wherever it breaches the surface; otherwise use Cut hole mode and slide the tube into place with Select whole cave + the Move tool.

Click the ground to spawn a blue GHOST of the cut, drag it into place, then press "Cut into the ground" to punch it straight through the terrain mesh. The ground stops existing there and the mesh grows a rock rim around the opening, so line a cave mouth up underneath and you can walk or drop in. Pick the shape first: a ball, an oriented box for a slot or a doorway, or a capsule for an arch. Resize or delete any committed cut below; undo removes the last one.
Entrance placed. Keep clicking to lay the path (the last point is the exit), then hit Generate.
This cave has no rig nodes to grab - lay a new cave instead.

Click the ground to lay a patch (brush radius wide, same shapes as a cut) that FILLS the ground back in wherever cuts overlap it - use it to trim the blank parts around each cut. A patch always beats the cuts it touches. Resize or delete any patch below; undo removes the last one.

One cell size for every carve and dug volume on the map: larger cells mean far fewer triangles. Applies to the whole map at once and re-meshes it; the regions below can still refine or coarsen single spots on top of it.

Click to paint a DETAIL region (brush radius wide): every carve it touches re-meshes at the chosen cell size - finer OR coarser than the default. Spend fine topology exactly where a cave needs to read clean; turn the cell up to thin out a carve that costs too much. Finer cells cost more triangles.

Drag across a carve wall, floor or ceiling to DIG rock away, like a clay brush: each pass carves a blended channel at the stamp size (set by the brush radius). Drag on open ground to gouge into the surface. One undo step per stroke.
Drag along a dug edge to SMOOTH it: each pass raises the Blend of every cut and fill under the brush, so creases and lumps along a dig stroke melt into one rounded surface. One undo step per stroke.
The rig points are too close together - spread them at least a few yards apart.

Flense the enemy for weapon damage plus {damage} and cause {overTime} bleeding damage over 18 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Cat Form only.
Each hit that lands adds 1 Old Blood (max 3).
Lets loose a valorous roar, granting you and party members within 40 yards 20% additional maximum health for 10 sec. Protection: they also take 5% less damage for the duration.

Fire 6 shots over 2.4 sec while moving. Each shot deals {damage} Physical damage and increases with Ranged Attack Power. Completing all 6 shots grants Coldsight Read for 10 sec: your next Long Draw deals 50% more damage, or your next Fell Shot deals 75% more. Starting either shot spends Read, even if interrupted.
Strike for 10% weapon damage plus {damage}. A hit restores 15 Focus and grants 1 Hunting Momentum. Damage increases with Attack Power through weapon damage.

Spends 2 Soul Fragments to command every undead servant to strike in unison. Graveguards taunt and brace, Warriors pin, Bone Mages expose magic defenses, and Gravewing rends all enemies hit. Reaping Command ignores and does not reset each servant's own ability cooldown.
Interrupts the target's spellcast and prevents casting from that school for 4 sec.

Returns a dead group member to life at your side with 35% health and mana. A Sunmender of level 16 or higher instead calls back every fallen member of the group within 30 yards and in your line of sight.
Enrage: your rage generation increases by 50% and your critical strike chance by 20% for 12 sec.
Spend everything: strike three times in a frenzy for 65% weapon damage plus {damage} each, always Enraging you. (Fury)

Spends your 3 Old Blood: strike for {damage}, instantly deal all the damage your Flense and Bloodrift would still have dealt, remove both bleeds, and restore {rage} energy. Works with zero combo points.
Heals a friendly target for {damage} and an additional amount over 15 sec. If the effect runs its full duration, it heals the target again for the same amount as the initial heal.
Each cast adds 1 Verdance (max 3), including a refresh of a bloom already ticking.
Heals the target for {damage} over 12 sec.
Each cast adds 1 Verdance (max 3), including a refresh of a bloom already ticking. At 3 Verdance, Fleetmend becomes Overbloom.
Heal the target for {damage} over 15 sec, once every 3 sec. Healing increases with Spell Power.

Surrounds you and your party with holy energy until death or replacement. Enemies that strike an affected ally in melee take {buff} Holy damage, and affected allies deal {buff} additional Holy damage with auto-attacks. Replaces your own Bastion Devotion. Another Paladin casting Requital Aura refreshes it instead of stacking.
Attack in a wide arc, dealing 18 to 24 Physical damage to all enemies in front of you. Above 5 targets the damage is reduced. When you dodge or parry, your next Revenge may cost no rage. (Protection)
Restore 10% of your living companion's maximum health every sec for 8 sec. If your companion is dead, revive it with 50% health instead.
Passively increases the threat generated by your Holy damage by 30%. Faithwarden only.
Summons a ring for 10 sec. Enemies crossing its perimeter are frozen for 4 sec. (Mage talent)
Finishing move that makes the target bleed every 2 sec for 24 sec: 72 damage plus 48 per combo point spent (5 combo points: {damage} total). Cat Form only.
The landed hit adds 1 Old Blood (max 3).

Imbue your weapon for 30 min. Each swing deals {damage} extra damage. Warspirit also gains 40% armor and 20% Stamina, takes 15% less damage, is immune to critical strikes from creatures, and generates two and three quarter times as much threat. Earthen Jolt forces its target to attack you for 3 sec, and Thunder Ward grants 10% damage reduction for 3 sec.

Brands an enemy for 15 sec. Your next 3 direct spells echo for 25% damage against the branded enemy, or copy 50% damage to it when cast against another target. Ruinbolt echoes also count as critical hits, without another critical damage multiplier.
Inscribe a rune of power at your feet for 15 sec: allies standing within 8 yd deal 10% more damage. (Mage talent)
Finishing move that wounds the target: it bleeds every 2 sec, for 6 sec plus 2 sec per combo point (5 combo points: 16 sec and {damage} total damage).
For {duration} sec, the next enemy hit that would kill you is denied, restoring you to 35% health instead.
Compel an enemy to attack you. During Ascension it also reduces all damage received by 15% for 4 sec without consuming a charge.
Enter a sacred state until death, increasing healing by 10%, spell critical chance by 5%, and reducing threat generated by 50%. Sunmender only.
Destroys one Dominion servant to restore 25% of your maximum health.
Increases movement speed by 35%, but sacrifices 2% of your maximum health each second. Cast again to cancel. It switches off at 20% health.
Imbue your weapon with the blood of your foes: you and your melee allies gain 10% attack speed and 10% damage for 20 sec.
Incapacitates the target for 8 sec without breaking Duskveil or starting a fight. Must be stealthed and out of combat. Any damage breaks the effect.
Fire a spray of bolts in an 8-yard cone (90 degrees) in front of you, knocking enemies back up to 20 yards from you. Knockback-immune enemies are unaffected. Deals no damage.
Scalds the enemy for {damage} Fire damage. Quick to cast.

Deal {damage} Holy damage to an enemy or heal a friendly target for {healing}. Damage increases with Spell Power; healing increases with Healing Power. Doctrine converts this damage into healing through your links. If no injured linked group member is within 30 yards, heal the lowest-health injured group member within 30 yards for 15% of the damage. Healing a group member also heals up to 2 other injured group members within 10 yards of that target and in your line of sight, each for 50% of the health restored. These extra heals cannot critically heal or create Doctrine links. (Doctrine signature)
Scratch through nearby targets within 6 yards for weapon damage plus {damage}. Awards 1 combo point per target hit. Reveals stealthed enemies in the sweep. Cat Form only.
Each hit that lands adds 1 Old Blood (max 3).
Fills you with Holy power for 30 sec, causing each of your melee swings to deal {damage} additional Holy damage.
Sears the enemy with agonizing fire for {damage} Fire damage. Quick to cast.
Your critical auto-attacks generate 10% more rage. (Arms)

Consumes all Condemnation and Fate Threads to pass sentence on the enemy. Each Thread increases damage by 6%. Added effects escalate at 20, 50, 80, and 100 Condemnation. Its damage scaling flattens after level 16.
Protect one ally for 30 sec. The first hit that leaves them below 35% health consumes the Vigil and heals them for {buff}. (Benison signature)
Deal {damage} total Nature damage over 15 sec, once every 3 sec. Damage increases with Ranged Attack Power.
Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy for {damage} Shadow damage.

Deal {damage} total Shadow damage over 18 sec, once every 3 sec. Damage increases with Spell Power. Vespers ticks can critically strike, using your spell critical chance and critical damage bonus. Vespers already includes 10% more damage and grants 1 Gloomtithe per tick on your Effigy. Reapplying your active Dirge to an enemy mob refreshes your existing Dirges on all living hostile mobs within 30 yards of you and in line of sight. This does not spread Dirge to new targets.
Spends 1 Wrack to execute an enemy below 20% health for {damage} Shadow damage. Refunds its Wrack if the claimed target dies within 5 sec.
Enter Gloamveil, increasing your Shadow damage by 25%. Cast it again to leave Gloamveil. (Vespers signature)
Steps through the shadows to your target, friend or foe, without breaking Duskveil. Stores up to 2 charges. (Rogue talent)
Your spells gain 50% critical strike chance against frozen targets. Fingers of Frost and Winter's Chill count as frozen. (Frost)
Reduce damage taken by 60% for 8 sec, but prevent attacks while active.
Slam the target with your shield for 50% weapon damage plus {damage} and massive threat. (Protection signature)

Blast a 10-yard cone in front of you. Your target, or the nearest enemy hit if your target is outside the cone, takes 24 to 30 Physical damage. Every other enemy in the cone takes 7 to 9 and bleeds for 12 damage over 6 sec. If the main target has your Bloodhook Wound, deal 1 wound tick immediately. Hitting an enemy grants 1 Hunting Momentum. Direct damage increases with Ranged Attack Power.
Silences the target for 4 sec. (Priest talent)
An instant strike for weapon damage plus {damage}. Awards 1 combo point.
While Redline is active, this button becomes Haymaker: 130% weapon damage plus 10, awards 2 combo points, and adds 1 Redline (max 4).
Siphons life from the enemy, causing {damage} Shadow damage over 30 sec and healing you for the damage done. (Affliction signature)
A lunging headbutt that interrupts the target's spellcast and locks that school for 4 sec.
Slams the opponent for weapon damage plus {damage}.
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec plus 4 sec per combo point (5 combo points: 32 sec).

Deal {damage} Holy damage. Damage increases with Spell Power. Doctrine converts this damage into healing through your links. If no injured linked group member is within 30 yards, heal the lowest-health injured group member within 30 yards for 15% of the damage.
Vanish into a cloud of smoke, increasing your chance to dodge by 30% for 8 sec.

Instantly heal an ally for {damage} or deal moderate Holy damage to an enemy. Either use generates 1 Devotion. During Ascension, a healing cast also heals allied players within 10 m of the target for half as much.
Increase your movement speed by 150% for 2 sec.
Tears at the enemy soul for {damage} Shadow damage and creates 1 Soul Fragment, up to 5.
Hurls a spectral lance for {damage} Shadow damage. Against your Ossuary Mark, 50% of its damage is added to the mark.
Summons a Soulwell for 3 min. While outside combat, group members can refill their Soul Stones up to 3. A Soul Stone restores 25% of maximum health and shares the potion cooldown.
Interrupts enemy spellcasting and prevents casting from that school for 4 sec.
Steals a beneficial magic effect from an enemy, transferring it to yourself.

Detonate a spirit bomb on an enemy, dealing {damage} Shadow damage to enemies within 8 yards of that target. Damage increases with Spell Power, can critically strike, and is reduced beyond 5 targets. Generate 20 Gloomtithe to prepare one bomb. Generation counts even while holding the maximum 5 Gloomtithe; spending charges is not required and adds no progress. Progress lasts between fights, up to one prepared bomb. Dying clears your progress and prepared bomb. Completing the cast consumes the prepared bomb, even if resisted. Cancellation or interruption preserves it. Starting a raid boss encounter clears your progress and prepared bomb. Cannot open a raid boss encounter with this spell.
Summons a spore burster onto the target area. After {duration} sec it bursts, healing allies for {healing} and dealing {damage} Nature damage to enemies within 8 yards.
At 3 Moontide it is 25% stronger and spends your Moontide.
Also applies Sporemending to each ally it heals. At full Verdance it is 25% stronger and spends your Verdance.

Shapeshift into a Sporemender, increasing your healing done by 20% and your armor by 40%, but reducing your movement speed by 20%. All of your caster-form spells stay usable. Lasts until you shift out. Shifting into any form grants Loping Stride, a short burst of movement speed. Cast again to return to caster form. (Groveheart signature)
A long lofted boot toward the aim point. The crowd loves it.
Fling yourself toward the aim point. A crossing ball sticks to you.
A quick sidestep burst toward the aim point.
Hammer the ball low and hard up the field.
Knock the ball along the ground toward the aim point.
Roll a firm pass to your targeted teammate, leading their run.
A keeper's punt, high and far.
Find your legs: move 50% faster for 4 sec.
Hold to build power, release to shoot at goal. Too much power sails over.
A fair harvest-truce shoulder. Sends them tumbling off the ball.
Increases your movement speed by 70% for 15 sec.

Summon 3 beasts for 12 sec. Each attacks every 2 sec for {damage} Physical damage. The shown damage includes 8% of your Ranged Attack Power before pet damage bonuses. The beasts snapshot Pack Ferocity when summoned, gaining 10% damage per stack. While Stampede is on cooldown, successful Pack Commands have a 20% chance to reset it, guaranteed after 5 failed chances. It cannot reset while the beasts are active. (Packlord)
Calls down a bolt of stellar fire, causing {damage} Arcane damage.

In Moonwing Form, each completed cast adds 1 Moontide (max 3). At 3 Moontide, this button becomes Sunwake: an instant strike for 80 to 100 Nature damage plus a 45 burn over 9 sec, restoring 35 mana and spending all 3.
A wild shot that disorients the target for {duration} sec. Any damage breaks the effect.
Conceals you in the shadows: enemies barely notice you, and you move at full speed. Attacking or taking damage breaks Duskveil. Cast again to step out.
Each opener you use from Duskveil adds 1 Gloam (max 3).
Protects one ally for 60 sec with 6 charges. Damage consumes a charge to heal 5% maximum health, once every 3 sec. (Shaman talent)
Hurl your weapon at the target for {damage}, stunning it for 3 sec.
Strike for weapon damage plus {damage} and advance Warspirit Cadence by 2 steps. Damage increases with Attack Power through weapon damage.
Passive: While Ancestral Strike is on cooldown, consuming Stormcast has a 25% chance to reset it. If the first 3 chances fail, the 4th always resets it. (Warspirit)
Your auto-attacks have a chance to let you cast Early Grave on a target at any health, costing no rage. (Arms)

Binds a Wraithborn to your will: an elite demon that rains heavy Shadow damage from afar. A long cooldown gates its devastating power. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.

Summons a Warfiend under the command of the Warlock. The Warfiend is a durable melee demon that wades into battle and holds its own. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.

Summons a Spellhound under the command of the Warlock. The Spellhound harries enemies from range with Gloombite and excels at hunting spellcasters. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.
Summons an Emberkin under the command of the Warlock. The Emberkin casts Felbolt at your enemies from afar. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.

Calls a Pyre Colossus down at the target area, dealing 64-79 Fire damage on impact. It fights for 30 sec without replacing your demon, burns nearby enemies every 2 sec, and generates 1 Wrack every 1 sec.

Summons a Duskborn under the command of the Warlock. The Duskborn is a fragile demon that strikes quickly and hits hard in melee. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.

Consume all Gloomtithe to summon a Tithefiend. It lasts 6, 8, 10, 12, or 15 sec at 1 to 5 stacks and attacks every 2 sec. Each attack deals 20 to 24 Shadow damage plus 8 per extra stack and increases with your Spell Power. At 5 stacks, the fiend grows larger and deals 25% more damage. It attacks only enemies within 35 yards that have your Dirge of Decay, preferring your Effigy. Without a target, it waits until one becomes available or its duration ends. Each hit restores 1% maximum Mana and echoes 15% of its damage to up to 3 other enemies with your Dirge of Decay. (Vespers signature)

Summons a Duskmurk under the command of the Warlock. This sturdy demon taunts enemies and uses Abyssal Chain to drag distant normal enemies back into reach. Bosses cannot be pulled. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.
Summon a Water Elemental to fight beside you, hurling Waterbolts at your target and channeling Water Jet. (Frost)

Judge an enemy beneath the Verdict of the Sun God for 30 sec. Final Edict and Dawnfall inscribe one charge on a successful hit. The ability that lands the third charge dictates the sentence: Final Edict unleashes devastating damage on the condemned; Dawnfall detonates the verdict, damaging and stunning nearby enemies for 1.5 sec.
Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by {damage}% per application. Stacks up to 5 times. Generates a high amount of threat.
Spends your 3 Moontide for a strike of {damage} Nature damage plus a {overTime} burn over 9 sec, and restores 35 mana: the mana choice. Moonsurge spends the same 3 Moontide, so pick one.

Requires a shield. Hurl a radiant disc that strikes and then bounces between nearby enemies. Each damaging impact generates 1 Devotion. Solar Reprisal makes Sunward Disc cost no mana, ignore its cooldown, and deal 20% more damage. Ascension empowers 5 bounces.
For 12 sec your single-target attacks also strike 1 nearby enemy for full damage. (Arms)

Consumes a heal-over-time effect on a friendly target to heal them for {damage}. Sporemending, Second Bloom, and Wildmend casts each add 1 Verdance; at 3 Verdance this button becomes Overbloom, which instantly heals every ally carrying your heal-over-time effects for 60% of what those effects had left. (Groveheart signature)

Consumes a heal-over-time effect on a friendly target to heal them for {damage}. Sporemending and Second Bloom plantings add Verdance; at 5 Verdance this button becomes Overbloom, which instantly heals every ally carrying your heal-over-time effects for 60% of what those effects had left. (Groveheart signature)
Sweep your claws through nearby enemies for {damage} damage. Causes extra threat. Bruin Form only.
Each hit that lands adds 1 Old Blood (max 3).
Blend into your surroundings: enemies barely notice you, and you move at 80% speed. Attacking or taking damage breaks Tactical Camo. Cast again to step out. (Fieldcraft)
Begins taming a beast to be your companion. It must be your level or lower and not an elite. Your pet follows you, attacks your enemies, and holds threat of its own. You may have one pet at a time.
Goads the target: your threat rises to match its most hated enemy and it is compelled to attack you for 3 sec.

Accelerates the flow of time for your group or raid, increasing attack, casting, and channeling speed by 30% for 15 sec. Allies recently affected by Temporal Acceleration or Storm Chorus are too exhausted to benefit. (Chronomancy)
Shifts the target a heartbeat out of the present, a temporal shell absorbing {damage} damage for 10 sec before the timeline snaps back.

Sends an echo cascading through your group: the target and up to four of their nearest allies are mended at once, healing for more on those who have lost the most health, and each marked for {duration} sec, drawing part of the Arcane damage you deal back through their echoes to heal them. Aether Surge and Aether Darts create an equal healing reserve from every group Echo, shared among marked allies below 60% health according to missing health. (Chronomancy)

Marks an ally with an echo of a healthier moment, mending {damage} health at once. For {duration} sec, {echoSinglePct}% of your other single-target Arcane damage and {echoAreaPct}% of your area Arcane damage heals them. Aether Surge and Aether Darts instead heal them for {echoDriverPct}% of the damage they deal.

Place a temporal hourglass at the selected location. Beneath an enemy, it suspends them for {hostilePveDuration} sec in PvE or {hostilePvpDuration} sec in PvP and prevents all actions; damage breaks the effect. At your feet or beneath a group ally, it grants stasis for {duration} sec, prevents damage and actions, restores {healing}% of maximum health, and makes cooldowns recover {selfCooldownRecovery}% faster for you or {allyCooldownRecovery}% faster for an ally. On empty ground, the hourglass waits for {groundDuration} sec and affects the first valid unit to step on it. The beneficial aura can be removed manually.
Draws an ally a moment forward in time, mending {damage} health as the body settles into its healthier future self. (Chronomancy signature)
Rewinds a fallen ally's timeline, returning them to life at your side with 35% of their health and mana, even in the thick of combat. (Chronomancy)

Sends an arcane wave through your group or raid, rewinding time to restore 30% of the damage each ally within 40 yards took over the last 5 seconds (up to 35% of their maximum health). Cannot be a critical effect. (Chronomancy)
A whistled signal spurs your group on, increasing attack, casting, and channeling speed by 10% for 10 sec. Allies recently affected by a group haste burst are too exhausted to benefit. (Rogue talent)
Thorns sprout from the target: melee attackers take {buff} Nature damage.
Blasts nearby enemies for {damage} damage and slows their attacks by 10% for 10 sec.

Passive: Arc Bolt, Skybranch, and Magma Burst grant Thunder, up to 5. Earthen Jolt consumes all Thunder and deals 25% more damage per Thunder (125% at 5). Faultwake consumes all Thunder and deals 20% more damage per Thunder (100% at 5). (Thundercall)

Call down a thunderclap, dealing {damage} Nature damage to enemies within 10 yards and slowing them by 50% for 5 sec. Restores 8% of your maximum Mana. Damage increases with Spell Power. (Thundercall)
Heal a friendly target for {damage}. Healing increases with Spell Power. Add the full heal before overhealing to Mending Current, up to 30% of the target's maximum health.
Surges {rage} energy and increases attack power by {buff} for {duration} sec. Cat Form only.
Leap 25 yards backward and break free of roots and movement slows. Landing grants 50% movement speed for 3 sec. If you have Hunting Momentum, refresh it and arm Re-entry for 12 sec.
Channels restorative energy for 4 sec, healing allies within 30 yd for 42 to 52 each second. (Druid talent)

Instantly shift into a swift fleet form, increasing movement speed by 40% and removing breakable roots and slows. You cannot use other abilities while shifted, but can shift in or out of combat, ideal for escaping. Shifting into any form grants Loping Stride, a short burst of movement speed.
Increase the Attack Power of allies within 30 yards by 10% for 30 min. (Marksmanship signature)

A blast of wind hurls all enemies within 8 yd 15 yd away from you and dazes them, slowing their movement by 50% for 4 sec. Enemy players are thrown into the air in a straight line: knocked off a ledge, they keep going and take falling damage, and a fatal fall counts as your kill.
First cast: anchors your shadow at your feet for 5 min. Recast within 40 m to return there, consuming the anchor and starting a 45 sec cooldown.
Spends 3 Soul Fragments to command all of your undead to deal 25% more damage and act 20% faster for 12 sec.

Consume 3 Pack Ferocity after your pet strikes for 42 to 53 Physical damage and claps every enemy within 6 yards for 57 to 75. The clap deals 50% more damage to enemies other than the main target. The strike and clap use Pack Ferocity's full 30% pet damage bonus and increase with the pet's Attack Power. For 8 sec afterward, the pet deals 25% more damage, attacks 35% faster, and makes Fell Shot cleave up to 2 enemies within 5 yards of the target.

Trigger your active weapon enchant. Pyrebrand: deal 54 to 64 Fire damage plus 30% of your Spell Power and gain 2 Thunder. Galeheart: strike with your weapon, advance Warspirit Cadence, and gain 20% attack speed for 6 sec. Stonebound: strike for 75% weapon damage, force the target to attack you for 3 sec, and take 20% less damage for 4 sec. Lifespring: consume Mending Current, heal for 125% of its remaining healing, and reduce the next hit within 8 sec by 50% of the health restored.

Ascend into the air, becoming immune to damage as you fly toward the enemy. After 2 sec, descend upon the target area for {damage} Holy damage and generate 1 Devotion. Ascension increases the impact damage by 50% and consumes 1 charge.

Deal {damage} Shadow damage over 15 sec, once every 3 sec. Damage increases with Spell Power and ticks can critically strike. Each tick shares healing equal to 20% of the health lost by the enemy among you and injured party members within 30 yards; in a raid, only your subgroup receives this healing. If you have at least 2 Gloomtithe charges, applying this effect consumes 2 to increase all its damage by 30%.
Melt from sight, entering Duskveil even in combat. You move at full speed while hidden. Lasts up to 10 sec.

Become ethereal for 4 sec, gaining 40% movement speed and 30% armor and becoming immune to roots, slows, and displacement. Enemies you pass through are Veil Marked for 6 sec, taking Holy damage each second, dealing 20% less damage to you, and generating extra threat. The first mark grants 1 Devotion. When the march ends, nearby marked enemies take a final burst. Ascension increases the burst by 50% and lightly pulls them toward you.
Takes Holy damage each second, deals 20% less damage to the Paladin who applied the mark, and generates additional threat toward that Paladin.
Step 10 yards forward through the veil.
For 6 sec: your Duskveil openers work without stealth and from any angle, you deal 10% more damage, and your first Lurker's Strike inside it hits for double. (Skulduggery)
Flick a poisoned dart for {damage} Nature damage. Awards 1 combo point.
Adds 1 Venom Ritual and extends your venom wound by 6 sec (the wound never goes above 20 sec).

Spends your 6 Venom Ritual: strike for 100 plus 55 per combo point, instantly deal all the damage your bleeds would still have dealt, then apply a fresh venom wound (120 damage over 20 sec). Restores 20 energy. (Knifework)

Links your suffering for 8 sec and generates up to 15 Condemnation from hostile hits. On yourself, reduces damage taken by 20%. On an ally, redirects up to 20% to you without taking you below 15% health.
Strike for weapon damage plus {damage} and heal 20% of your maximum health. Only usable within 20 sec of killing an enemy.
Consume 3 Gloomtithe charges to rupture an enemy for {damage} Shadow damage. Damage increases with Spell Power and can critically strike. Requires 3 charges and consumes them even if resisted.
Devours a magic effect (a beneficial one from an enemy, or a harmful one from an ally) and heals you for 6% of your maximum health. Only usable when there is an effect to devour.
Rain arrows over an 8-yard area for 3 sec. Enemies in the area take {damage} Physical damage every 0.5 sec. Damage increases with Ranged Attack Power.

Strike with high threat and generate 1 Devotion. A successful strike has a 20% chance to grant Solar Reprisal for 8 sec; each successful block has a 25% chance. Solar Reprisal empowers your next Sunward Disc, Hammer of Grace, or Mending Light. Ascension also grants a small absorption shield.

Passive: Dual-wield attacks have no extra miss chance. Every 3rd landed weapon attack triggers 2 Galeheart Echoes for 25% Nature damage and grants Stormcast for 12 sec. Stormcast makes your next Arc Bolt, Jolt, or Mending Waters instant and cost 50% less Mana. Ancestral Strike counts as 2 attacks. (Warspirit)
Spin in a deadly arc, striking all nearby enemies for {damage}. (Fury talent)
Immediately restore 30% of your maximum health.
Coax a fallen ally into sudden bloom, returning them to life at your side with 35% of their health and mana, even in the thick of combat. (Groveheart)
Slash the target for {damage} Physical damage and slow it by 40% for 10 sec. Damage increases with Attack Power.
Hurls a bolt of nature energy for {damage} Nature damage.
In Moonwing Form, each completed cast adds 1 Moontide (max 3). At 3 Moontide, Moonseed becomes Moonsurge and Skyfall becomes Sunwake.
Stings the enemy from range, incapacitating it for up to 4 sec. Any damage breaks the effect. (Survival signature)
You descend into the collapsed reliquary.
You climb back to Brother Halven at the reliquary ruin.
You descend into the drowned shrine at the marsh's edge.
You climb back to Brother Halven at the marsh's edge.
You step into the warm, flower-scented halls of Dawnhold Castle.
You slip back out onto the sunlit garden lawn.
You step through the moongate: the air turns to cold water and pale light, and the singing closes over your head.
You surface through the moongate into the mountain night.
The air goes cold. Something vast breathes below...
You stagger back into the mountain wind.
You descend into the Hollow Crypt...
You close your front door behind you.
You close your front door behind you.
You close your front door behind you.
Hammerfall echoes through the Halls of the First Tempering.
You step away from the first forge and breathe freely again.
The forge-lift shudders and sinks; hammerfall rises to meet you.
The lift hauls you back into the open air of the keep.
The opened gate leads deeper into the Crucible.
You leave the silent depths of the Crucible.
The opened gate leads into a molten assembly hall.
You leave the assembly line and return to the Crucible.
Heat shimmers above the sealed waters of the Crucible.
You step away from the Crucible and breathe freely again.
You pass through the sealed royal door.
You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.
You cross the threshold of the Abandoned Crypt.
You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.
You wade down into the Sunken Bastion...
You climb out of the drowning dark.
You step into the cold, silent halls of the Last Keep.
You pull the keep door shut and step back into the Drakelands wind.
You step through the idol maw onto a ledge high above the basin. Waterfalls thunder from the rim, and far below, something enormous wades the ford.
You pass back beneath the stone fangs into the Palmreach sun.
Veiled Edge adds 100% weapon damage to your next Lurker's Strike instead of 50%. It does not increase the flat bonus or stack with the stealth bonus.

Restoring health with Whispered Prayer, Solemn Prayer, or Urgent Prayer increases your next Choirmend's healing by 10%, stacking up to 3 times. Each cast grants at most one stack. Choirmend consumes all stacks when it finishes casting. Damage taken no longer delays your spellcasting.
Finishing Choirmend with 3 stacks makes your next Whispered Prayer within 60 sec instant and increases its healing by 100%. This benefit does not stack; earning it again refreshes its duration.
Increases attack and casting speed by 7.5%.
Increases Strength by 10 and Stamina by 10.
Increases attack power by 25. Your weapon critical strikes have a 50% chance to grant Gravemight, increasing attack power by 40 for 10 sec.
Increases attack and casting speed by 4% and Hit by 3%. Your weapon critical strikes splinter the target with Bonesplinter, bleeding it for 5 damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

Temporal Echo converts 50 percent of your other single-target Arcane damage into healing. Aether Surge and Aether Darts instead convert 200 percent of their damage. Damage taken no longer delays your spellcasting.
Temporal Cascade's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec and its mana cost is reduced by 30 percent.
Sweeping Claws has a 30 percent chance to bank an additional Old Blood.
Marrowbreak hits 30 percent harder, and its emergency guard no longer replaces the strike.
Venom Ritual's energy refund rises to 20 per builder.
Venom Dart's cooldown is reduced to 4 sec.
Long Draw critical strikes extend Cold Focus by 2 sec, up to 6 sec per activation.
Increases Strength by 10 and Stamina by 10.

Care for a Card Duel? Best of three, winner takes the bragging rights.
Measure twice, panic once. Then measure again, just to be safe.
Soot washes off. Wolves do not. I will take the soot.
The mountain forgets nothing, {playerName}, and neither do I. Let us see what you have done.
Mind the damp on the pages, {playerName}. The fen eats more books than readers ever will.
Every deed worth doing is worth writing down twice, {playerName}: once for the ledger and once for the fireside.
Three contracts a week, posted every reset. No signing, no fees: see one through and the seals are yours.
Nothing leaves my kitchens half-cooked, {className}. Sit, eat, then get back out there.
The forge marks its own. Bring me a sigil from the Crucible and I will fit you for war.

That dummy behind me never swings back and never goes down, {className}. What matters is the tally: your Damage Meters count every blow you land on it. Target it and open the meters, and I will walk you through the rest.
Straw first, shells second, {playerName}. An effigy teaches your arm the swing; the scuttlers down the strand teach it to land on something that minds.
Your weekly rewards await. Choose one item from your earned choices after the Crucible reset.
The terraces give what the mountain allows, {className}. I sell seed and compost, and if a crop of yours comes up withered I will work the husks back into good soil for you.

Good soil and fair weather, {playerName}. Buy a seed from me, sow it in one of those beds, and go about your day. It keeps growing while you are away, and it never spoils. Your Harvest Journal (Shift+K, or the Farming row of your Professions window) lists every planted bed and its timer.
Marsh rice and bog beet seed, {className}, and compost to feed them. The paddies drain slow, so mind where you tread.
Mind the edging, {playerName}, these beds are the pride of the parterre. Seed and compost are what I sell, and I will turn any withered husks you carry into more of it.

Fresh off the crossing, {playerName}? Warden Tam keeps the Gauntlet on the strand just south of my pier: run his lanes first and your legs will thank you. Every keeper on this shore hands you to the next when your work is done, and the card at the top of your screen always knows the way. When the vale calls you back, ring the bell standing beside my pier and the crossing will set you down in Eastbrook town.
Fog is on the Mere again. When the lanterns go out on the water, wise folk stay ashore.
It opened right where the nets dry. Right there, where I stood every morning of my life. I do not go down to the shore anymore. I do not go much of anywhere anymore.
Blrb-glub... sorry, been listening to those fish-men too long.
Never trust a fish with good manners. The polite ones are planning something.
Whole dig's crawling with those dirt-caked vermin!
Help me finish a shield! Click the supplies I call for. Quick hands earn a better medal.
The forge answers to me, {className}. Bring good ore and it will answer to you too.
The sands remember every victory. Spend your honor well.
If it grows, I have argued with it. If it grows well, I won.
Hand me that barrow, would you? These lawns do not walk themselves, whatever the hamlet thinks.
Wyrmwatch holds the gate. Has held it forty years. It will hold it tonight.
Mind how you go on the lawns. The garden keeps them trimmed, and it likes them tidy.
Great flight down the canyon. Speak with me whenever you need a magical updraft back to Zephyr at The Shear.
The thermals howling off the cliffs of The Shear are fierce today. Ready to strap into the mechanical glider and test your wings through the slalom course?

The gourds are lit and the lanterns are up, so it must be Gourdlight Eve. I have an errand for you every day of it, in Eastbrook, Fenbridge and Highwatch. Do it and I will pay you in sweets. Bring the sweets to me, at any of my stalls, and I will trade you something to wear.
Mind the paths between the stones. The ones beneath them have earned their quiet.
Seals for honors, friend. Nothing on my shelves will sharpen a blade, but every hall in Highwatch will know where you earned it.
Looking for a party? Every crypt, bastion and temple on this map has a name on my list. Tell me where you are headed.

Welcome to Lantern Hall, {className}. Tobias keeps the week's contracts on the board, Garrick trades our seals for honors worth wearing, and Mira will find you a party for any door below the mountain. Bring back a trophy and it hangs in the hall behind me.
Every boat in this cove owes the Old Beacon its keel. Speak quick, the tide will not wait.

Come in off the quay and warm your hands. The ship at our pier sails up the long east coast to Wickharbor and back again. Far to the west, the other ferry runs between Eastbrook and the Nightbloom. The map on the wall shows both crossings. Rest by the fire before the climb to Wyrmwatch.
Do not mind the shadows under my eyes. Someone has to stay awake while the garden dreams.
Come in off the cold. The lodge fire never goes out, so long as I draw breath.
Mud remembers every footprint, and so do the herbs. Tread kindly here.
Mind the thicket west of the road. The webs are thick as sailcloth this season.
Quiet now. The drums count everything that walks under the trees, and they have already counted you.
Proof of the heroic depths buys the finest rings and pendants in Highwatch. Show me your marks.
Quiet now. The herd knows every sound this valley makes, and so do I.
A creature has stolen a soldier's face. Read the standing orders and the watch ledger, question all four guards, then come back and name the one whose story contradicts our records.
It could be worse. Usually is. Sit, eat, and tell me which way the trouble is walking today.

Come in out of the damp, friend, and mind the step down to the fire. The kettle is on, the benches are warm, and the rooms upstairs are dry. Travelers from Fenbridge swear the marsh road is quiet by day, but nobody walks it after dark. Sit a while and rest your feet.

Every hero the vale has ever thanked stood where you stand now, {className}, and not one of them knew which end of a blade to hold. That is what this shore is for. Ask, practice, and fail where failing is free.
Nine and thirty years this lamp has burned on my watch. It will not go dark on yours.
Few of your kind have stood beneath these boughs, {className}. Walk gently, and be welcome.
Mind the lamps, friend. Past this gate the sun gives up and the flowers take over.
Stay in the lamplight, friend. The wood counts everyone who passes the gate.
Welcome to Moonrest, where the flowers do our dawning for us.
The wold was old before the first hearth was lit. Walk softly. It remembers.
Mind the loose shale, {className}. The mountain has been... restless of late. I intend to learn why.
Every light in this valley remembers something, {playerName}. Help me listen.
Keep your blade close, {className}. The Vale is not what it was.
I have set more bones this one month than in ten years of mending fishing falls. The breaks do not leave much of what they take. Come back to me whole, if you can manage it.
Wheal Patience. The name was a joke when we sank the shaft. Nobody is laughing now.
The willows told me you were coming before your boots left the bridge.
Pikes first, {className}, then everyone. That is the whole of it, and it has kept this camp alive.
Smell that? Smoked eel. Half this town stands on stilts I bought with it.
Sound timber, true steel, and honest work. Members of the Compact may draw from our stores.
Keep a lamp lit and a road open. The Lanternwardens supply those who stand the watch with us.
The Gilt Measure trades on what the coast gives up, and pays for what it learns. Our stores are open to those of recognized standing.
The four allied factions post assignments across the realm every day. If an assignment does not suit your skills, you may request one daily reassignment.
Mind where you step. Every root in these rows is older than the town, and they remember.
I clock every run that comes down these lanes, {playerName}, and I have seen far worse footwork. The path behind me climbs to the practice yard: that is where footwork turns into swordwork.
Panwick salts the fish of half the south. When the pans stop, people go hungry. So the pans do not stop.
Pull up a bench, {className}. Grissel here swears the big eel under Fenbridge is a myth. I've had my hand on him twice. Twice! Slippery as a tax collector, and near as long as this bench.

Don't mind Amos. Forty years cutting peat and I've pulled more strange things out of this bog than he's pulled eels: boots, bones, a helmet with the head still worried about it. Warm yourself, the fire's free.
Every map of this marsh I've ever bought was wrong within a season. The water moves the paths, and the paths move the water. So I draw my own, and I sit here where it's dry while the ink sets.
Drove forty head down the causeway and lost two to the mire before Fenbridge. Maudie's ale is the only thing on this road that never lets a man down. Buy your own, mind.
The sea gives, the sand keeps, and the jungle takes. Stay on the strand, stranger.
Mind where you put your feet. Half this moor is peat and the other half is pretending.
Bread still warm, water still sweet. The Hollow provides, and so do I.
Dry boots, dry bread, dry powder: at Fenbridge you get two of the three on a good day.
Wool, hardtack, and steel-shod boots: Highwatch runs on all three, and I am short of everything.
Steel and salt, {className}, it is all I have left to hand out. Take it and make the breaks regret opening where I could reach them.

My counter keeps exactly one thing for sale, {playerName}: a spare pouch for what you pick up along the way, when your lesson calls for it. Everything else here is salvage bound for the vale. Coin buys the pouch, and work earns the coin. That is the whole economy, and it never gets more complicated. Only bigger.
Every crate in this yard crossed forty miles of ash to get here. Treat them kindly.
Welcome to Lanternmere, where the harvest never ends and neither does the work.
Every break sings before it opens, if you have the ear for it. I can hear three of them stirring on the island right now, and one of them is close.
A Riftbound band remembers the break that made it, {className}. Bring me the band, and the essence the breaks shed, and I will teach it to remember more.
Breathe through your nose. You get used to the brine. Mostly.
A {className} with working arms, good. The wreck line pays well, if the crabs leave you enough fingers to count it.
Wreckwood, rope, and dead men's cargo. The sea pays my wage, when the Warden lets it.
You walked the pass alive. Good. Icemantle should hear of it.
Quiet feet and a short blade keep you breathing out here. Speak quick, for I am due back in the reeds.
I tracked cultists through the fen at your side, and the trail led here. The peaks are worse, {className}. Stay sharp.
If the snow speaks, do not answer. Down here it is mostly the hedges, and they talk a great deal.
Keep low. Sound carries strangely off the glass, and the gate below has ears.
We bury them deep here, and we ring the bells so they remember to stay down.

Borrow my duskweave cloak. Slip in behind each dispatch carrier and lift his orders. Stay out of the lantern beams: a lantern guard sees straight through the enchantment, and a carrier feels you if you brush against him.
No delays. The watch is waiting for these orders.
These sealed orders are for the captain. Keep your distance.
I have a dispatch to deliver. Move along.
Official business. Keep the path clear.
